name: Media Players Connector
description: Control VLC, Elisa, and other MPRIS2 media players over D-Bus and launch local media.

tools.name: list_players
tools.description: List active MPRIS2 media player D-Bus services (e.g. VLC, Elisa).

tools.name: get_playback_status
tools.description: Read PlaybackStatus and Metadata from an active MPRIS2 player.

service.description: MPRIS2 D-Bus service name, e.g. org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.vlc

tools.name: control_playback
tools.description: Send Play, Pause, PlayPause, Next, Previous, or Stop to an MPRIS2 player.

service.description: MPRIS2 D-Bus service name, e.g. org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.vlc

tools.name: play_media
tools.description: Open a local audio or video file in VLC or Elisa.

path.description: Path to the local media file.
